fact: Cashback is a share of the U.S. dollar value of each Qualifying Card Transaction, 4% in the Standard tier's first band and up to 5% depending on the user's tier

Standard pays 4% on the first $2,500 of spend in a calendar month, 1% from $2,500 to $4,000 and nothing above $4,000. Pro pays 4.5% to $8,000, 2% to $10,000, 1% to $12,000 and 0.5% above. VIP pays 5% to $20,000, 2% to $30,000, 1% to $40,000 and 0.5% above. Each rate applies only to the spend inside its band, and spend resets at the start of each calendar month

fact: No separate monthly, annual or lifetime cap applies beyond the band schedule. The Terms of Use say Ethena Pay does not at present apply one and reserves the right to add such caps, publishing them on the Pricing page before they take effect
The FAQ's worked example: $9,000 of Pro spend in a month earns 4.5% on $8,000 and 2% on $1,000, $380 in all

fact: Cashback is paid in AVAX, converted at the AVAX to U.S. dollar rate at the time of credit, which Ethena Pay sets in good faith from one or more pricing sources

fact: Only settled transactions earn cashback. Settlement usually takes one to three business days, and settled cashback is calculated and paid in a batch once a day, ordinarily within several days of the purchase and no later than 30 days
An amount below the minimum transfer size is carried forward and paid in full once it reaches the minimum

Cash advances and ATM withdrawals, purchases of crypto, stablecoins, NFTs or securities, gambling, gift cards, peer-to-peer transfers, account funding, loan repayments, and fees or taxes earn no cashback
Cashback is reversed if the purchase is refunded, charged back or found ineligible, and a refund also takes the amount out of the month's spend total

fact: Purchases in other currencies carry the card network's conversion fee, around 1% for most currencies, passed through at cost. Fees earn no cashback
A time-limited Promotion may pay a higher rate on specific transactions, ordinarily in place of standard cashback
The referral bonus is $30 credited in AVAX
